items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: she was a friend of Mrs. Williams and them, but I never met her.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Now, speaking of opera singers, did you ever hear Sissqretta Jones?
No, I tell you who -- she was called Black Patty.

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I never saw George Walker and Ada Walker, but I knew Bert Williams and Mrs. Williams because she came to the ship with me when I sailed for Europe the first time, Bert Williams' wife with his nieces because, as I say, she went with me, his oldest niece, Lottie.

ctx.x: Where'd you live in New York?

I lived, yes, one while I lived at 233 West 136th Street. And that was Bert Williams' niece. His oldest niece and I lived there. We had the apartment. And let me see, where else did I live? Oh, 287 Edgecomb, 287 Edgecomb, we had a --
